description: The search to use for coverage. Sweeps each area with a grid of map points live against Google Maps, as a background job, the same search the Lyre Leads Search page runs. In Houston this found 1,061 roofing contractors where paging from one centre found 255. Costs 1 token per NEW business (one new lead costs one token); listings the account already holds cost nothing (a small per-page minimum applies). Every new business is enriched from its website (the emails it publishes, found and not checked, its owner where the site or a US registry names one) and relevance-checked. Returns job_id: poll get_job_status with kind "search" until finished is true, then read the leads with get_search_results. If an area name fits more than one place, the call returns the candidates with ids and starts nothing: ask the user which one they mean and resend with that id. At most two searches run at once per account.

areas.description: Area names like "Houston, Texas", or ids from find_areas

country.description: Country name, as listed by find_areas

detail.description: full (default): every new business is a lead, read from its website as described above. listing: the Google Maps listing only (name, address, phone, website address, rating, reviews, category, hours, location), with no website read, no emails, no relevance check and no monthly re-check, at 1 token per 5 new listings. Use listing only when the user asks for listings, phone numbers only, or the cheapest option. A listing can be made a full lead later with enrich_leads, for the rest of a lead (0.8 token each).

mode.description: grid (default here) covers the whole area; city pages from the centre

query.description: Business keyword, e.g. "roofing contractor" or "cosmetic dentist"

name: search_areas
title: Search whole areas
